title: 设置：切深色外观并刷新后保持
description: 通用页的外观是原生 select；选中深色后根元素应进入 dark，刷新后仍深色。

steps.eval: (() => { const s=[...document.querySelectorAll('select')].find(el=>[...el.options].some(o=>o.textContent.trim()==='深色')); if(!s) throw new Error('no appearance select'); const o=[...s.options].find(o=>o.textContent.trim()==='深色'); s.value=o.value; s.dispatchEvent(new Event('input',{bubbles:true})); s.dispatchEvent(new Event('change',{bubbles:true})); return s.value; })()
